title: Temporary Total Rating Schedule (Disability Compensation)
content:
A temporary total rating pays Disability Compensation at a total rate for a period of hospitalization or convalescence for a service-connected disability. The values below are identical at every tier, from Disability Compensation (10% Combined Rating) through Disability Compensation (100% Combined Rating).

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Temporary total monthly rate | 3938.58 USD |
| Hospitalization that triggers a temporary total rating | Continuous hospitalization for more than 21 days |
| Initial convalescence period | From 1 month up to 3 months |
| Extension of a convalescence period | No more than 9 further months in total |

**Boundary illustrations (hypothetical)**

- Continuous hospitalization of 21 days does not exceed 21 days; continuous hospitalization of 22 days does.
- An initial convalescence period set at 3 months is within the limit; a request for a fourth initial month is not. Extensions granted at 4 months and then 5 months total 9 further months, the most that can be added.
- The temporary total monthly rate of 3938.58 is the same amount whether the award otherwise carries Disability Compensation (30% Combined Rating) or Disability Compensation (90% Combined Rating).
